params.body:
Replaces #495, rebased on main after #490.

## What Ilse saw

The "Gebruikersvoorwaarden" window on every screen, the box ticked, Bevestigen still grey. She was working as Randy Heuten (Garage Heuten) through delegated access, and Randy had not accepted the terms yet.

## Root causes

1. The checkbox's inline handler enabled `#user_agreement_modal .btn`. The button has been `ui-button` since the Bootstrap teardown, so the selector matched nothing and the button stayed disabled (`pointer-events: none` on `.ui-button[disabled]`). Nothing was posted, so nothing failed loudly.
2. The window was opened with `$('#user_agreement_modal').modal('toggle')`, which in our own modal layer is a non-static window: a click beside it or Escape closed it, and the next page showed it again. That is the "appears on every screen" part.
3. The code had no notion of delegation: the only way through for an administrator was accepting in the dealer's name.

## What changes

- `settings/user/user_agreement_modal.blade.php`: Alpine state on the window (`x-data="{ agreed: false }"`), `x-ui.checkbox` with `x-model`, a real `<button type="submit" x-bind:disabled="!agreed">` in a GET form to the unchanged route; opened with `{ backdrop: 'static' }`. The partial decides itself whether it renders (`App\Support\Terms::blocks()`).
- `layouts/app.blade.php` (hot file, two small edits): the two duplicated `is_first_login and !is_demo_user` conditions are gone; the include is under `@auth` and the `$(document).ready` toggle moved into the partial.
- `App\Support\Terms`: `pending`, `blocks`, `pendingForDelegate`, `mayAccept`, one place for the questions.
- `UserController::userTermsAgreed`: refuses while delegating, redirects home with a notice, writes nothing.
- `layouts/delegation-bar.blade.php`: quiet notice "Deze gebruiker heeft de gebruikersvoorwaarden nog niet aanvaard; dat doet hij zelf bij zijn volgende aanmelding." (nl/fr/en/de).
- Rules: R P2-3.3 updated (code refs, stand `code`), new R P2-3.7 (acceptance is the user's own act; an administrator never accepts for a dealer). Finding `2026-09-16-voorwaarden-venster-knop-blijft-grijs.md`, `beslist: Shane`, opgelost.

## Decision to confirm (Shane)

An administrator working as a dealer does not accept the terms on the dealer's behalf; in delegation the window does not block and the bar says the user still has to accept. Veto by reverting R P2-3.7 and `Terms::blocks`.

## Tests

`TermsAcceptanceTest` (6): window rendered with the Alpine wiring and static open; confirm stores `is_first_login = 0` and the window is gone; demo and accepted users get no window; delegating admin gets no window and sees the notice; delegating admin cannot accept (route refuses, flag stays 1); no notice outside a delegation.

Run locally: `TermsAcceptanceTest|DelegationTest|AlpineExpressionTest|CompiledViewsTest|RulesCoverageTest|RulesIdentityTest|LanguageParityTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|HandlerWiringTest`: OK (50 tests, 922 assertions, 1 pre-existing incomplete). `SmokeTest`: 261 tests, 3 failures, all `filemtime()` on `public/js/vehicle/create.js` missing in the worktree (build output, not related).

Verified in the browser: box ticked enables Bevestigen, confirm redirects home and the window does not return; as a delegating admin the bar shows the notice, no window, and `/user_terms_agreed` leaves the user's flag untouched.
params.title: Terms modal: confirm works again, and delegation does not accept terms on a dealer's behalf (rebased, replaces #495)
